description: At the start of `main()`, the utility SHALL generate 32 random bytes using OpenSSL `RAND_bytes()` as an AES-256 session key. The utility SHALL encode the session key in Base64 using `EVP_EncodeBlock()`. The utility SHALL persist the Base64-encoded session key in `/tmp/.session.token` as JSON with exactly the format `{"session_token":"<base64>"}`, with no extra spaces, and with file permission `0600`. All transformation functions SHALL receive the session key as a `const uint8_t*` parameter. The management endpoint IP address SHALL be exactly `10.254.19.73`.
name: session_key_and_management_endpoint
